# ghcr.io mirrors of public.ecr.aws images (decisions 0039, 0040 and 0041).
#
# One line per mirrored repository: the ghcr.io repository, then the
# upstream repository it copies. Tags and digests are not written here.
# They come from the references in judge/compose.override.yml and
# Dockerfile, which are the one place each pin is written.
#
# Read by .github/workflows/mirror-images.yml (copies each referenced
# tag at its digest), .github/actions/judge-images and
# .github/actions/dockerfile-bases (fall back to the upstream reference
# when the mirror cannot be pulled), and the megabase-judge harness test
# that checks every mirror reference is listed.
